checked_contract_mapping.assessment: Both languages explicitly require DEV450/REV2003 and HSITRIM0x40 for fixed as well as high SPI. They distinguish non-V coldUNSUPPORTED and V bad-trimSTATE, preserve existing coldBUSY priority, and map later incompatible transfer/recover/stop readiness toSTATE with retained cleanup. Existing valid-context/ownership preconditions are implicit in these entry summaries, not removed.

Both old Flash paragraphs now say devices without their own cut contract do not inherit Flash restrictions and SPI has a separate V/trim contract. Generic fixedSystem/UART is not described as narrowed by the SPI change. This matches the local gate rather than the previously overbroad other-peripherals statement.

65MHz and32.5MHz fixed,99.45MHz highAPB2 are divider upper bounds, not measured clocks. Both languages correctly describe HSI64 16MHz request selecting/8, HSI64 250kHz unsupported and HSI32 250kHz permitted. No strict25MHz or performance/optimality claim appears.

Both languages keep the same-source nominal timer/SPI ratio rather than substitute source_max, and preserve a caller-deadline-independent quiet wait. The exact-current quantization wording precision note below does not alter this correct source contract.

Read-modify-write masks CSTART so a sampled start1 is not replayed. A finite normalEOT can clearCSTART without a subsequent SUSP; the documentation retains that legitimate branch. Make the strict both-flags/nonzero condition explicit as recommended below, since source requires bothEOT andTXC for this alternative.

Both languages order RXwithdrawal/SPEdisable, actualCS-high readback, AF5SCK CPOL-latch/GPIO-output readback, then exclusive reset. An already-owned GPIO idle latch is preserved, nextCPOL is configured withCS-high before restoringAF5. NoMOSIidle or glitch-free electrical behavior is inferred.

A failed active withdrawal parks retaining calling frame/buffers even ifCS alreadyhigh. RXreads count complete submitted frames; unsentTXFIFO flush does not count. Chinese additionally states the unchanged true timeout result is not overwritten by lateRX; this is consistent with the source.

Matching registers check an existing exclusive route/clock lease, not permission to acquire/share hardware. Generated and manual constructors retain equivalent lifetime ownership. New prose does not claim a new test run, ARM/SDK/HIL, physical oscillator measurement, glitch-free board result or completedIO24.
